bug-fix-plan.argument: Redirects for a retired short code kept returning the old target instead of 404, because cache_layer never invalidated on retirement.
bug-fix-plan.observed: Resolving a short code shortly after its link was retired still returned the stale target URL.
bug-fix-plan.expected: Resolving a retired short code returns :not_found immediately, matching lookup_engine's own invariant.
bug-fix-plan.scope: cache_layer's own invalidation path only; lookup_engine's Postgres-backed lookup already behaves correctly.
